The practice

Let the image speak.

  1. Set an intention. Bring a question, a feeling, or a situation into focus.
  2. Draw a card. Notice the expressions, gestures, and details that first catch your attention.
  3. Reflect. Consider how the image relates to your question. The interpretation is yours.

Draw again to explore another perspective. Shuffle rearranges the remaining deck. Clear returns the current card to its resting state without restoring it to the deck.

To begin again, select Reset history in the footer. This clears your current card and drawn-card history, making the entire collection available again.

Cards appear once per cycle. A new cycle begins after the entire collection has been drawn. Your place is saved in this browser when storage is available.

The collection

Photographic cards selected for intuitive interpretation.

The collection draws from expressive photography and shared visual culture. Each card links to its Pinterest source, with images credited to their respective creators.

The images are presented without assigned meanings. Your perspective shapes each reading.
